verdict.rationale: Relay documents real-time expense categorization that syncs automatically to accounting software (QuickBooks Online and Xero), which touches the GL-coding part of the story. Nothing shows the categorization is AI-driven or automatic rather than manual, and nothing covers multiple entities. Missing for 10: evidence of AI or automatic GL code assignment, GL code mapping specifics, multi-entity coding support, close-acceleration claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI automatically assign GL codes to transactions across entities to accelerate close

citations.quote: Capture receipts, categorize expenses in real time, and sync everything to your accounting software automatically.
Relay syncs ultra-detailed, easy-to-understand transaction data directly into QuickBooks Online and Xero.
